description: Ministry of Defence - Order to declare the Extradition law between people's republic of China and Sri lanka
reasoning: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring that the provisions of the Extradition Law apply to China pursuant to a bilateral treaty. It deals with the legal framework for extradition, specifically modifying the application of an existing law (Extradition Law, No. 8 of 1977) in accordance with an international treaty. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, legal amendments, and international agreements affecting the legal framework).
